Example Sentence: 아주 먼 옛날, 하늘나라 임금님에게 직녀라는 딸이 있었어요.
Sentence Translation: A very long time ago, the King of the Heavens had a daughter named Jiknyeo.

Example Sentence: 직녀는 마음씨가 착하고 베를 잘 짜는 걸로 유명했어요.
Sentence Translation: Jiknyeo was famous for her kind heart and her weaving skills.

Example Sentence: 직녀는 매일 부지런하게 베를 짰어요.
Sentence Translation: Jiknyeo wove diligently every day.

Example Sentence: 직녀가 짠 옷감은 반짝반짝 빛이 났어요.
Sentence Translation: The fabric Jiknyeo wove shone brightly, twinkling.

Example Sentence: 직녀 공주님은 어쩜 저렇게 착하고 부지런하실까요?
English: how on earth / how can it be
Sentence Translation: How can Princess Jiknyeo be so kind and diligent?

Example Sentence: 소를 몰고 있는 한 청년을 만나게 됐어요.
Sentence Translation: She met a young man herding cows.

Example Sentence: 견우와 직녀는 처음 본 순간부터 서로 사랑에 빠졌어요.
Sentence Translation: From the moment they first saw each other, Gyeonu and Jiknyeo fell in love.

Example Sentence: 두 사람이 일을 하지 않는다는 이야기를 들은 임금님은 두 사람을 불러 혼을 냈어요.
Sentence Translation: Hearing that the two were not working, the King called them in and scolded them.

Example Sentence: 하지만 곧 두 사람은 약속을 지키지 않고 다시 놀러 다니기 시작했어요.
Sentence Translation: However, the two soon broke their promise (did not keep it) and started playing around again.

Example Sentence: 그 모습에 임금님은 마음이 약해졌어요.
English: to soften one's heart / to weaken in resolve
Sentence Translation: Seeing them like that the King's heart softened.
Etymology: Pure Korean (마음) + Sino-Korean (약 弱) + Pure Korean

Example Sentence: 지금 당장 직녀는 은하수 서쪽으로, 견우는 은하수 동쪽으로 가라!
Sentence Translation: Right this instant, Jiknyeo, go to the west of the Milky Way, and Gyeonu, go to the east of the Milky Way!

Example Sentence: 견우와 직녀는 눈물을 흘리며 말했어요.
Sentence Translation: Gyeonu and Jiknyeo said, shedding tears.

Example Sentence: 견우와 직녀가 흘린 눈물이 비로 변해 땅으로 떨어졌어요.
English: to turn into / to change into
Sentence Translation: The tears shed by Gyeonu and Jiknyeo turned into rain and fell to the earth.

Example Sentence: 두 사람은 서로의 이름을 부르며 눈물을 펑펑 흘렸어요.
Sentence Translation: The two called each other's names and cried profusely.

Example Sentence: 비 때문에 홍수가 나서 동물들이 살 집을 잃기도 했어요.
Sentence Translation: Because of the rain, floods occurred and animals even lost their homes.

Example Sentence: 우리가 몸을 이어서 다리를 만들면, 두 사람이 다리 위에서 만날 수 있을 거야.
Sentence Translation: If we connect our bodies to make a bridge, the two can meet on the bridge.

Example Sentence: 견우는 하늘나라에서 부지런하기로 유명한 농부였어요.
Sentence Translation: Gyeonu was a farmer famous in the heavens for his diligence.

Example Sentence: 견우와 직녀는 결혼한 뒤에 매일 놀러 다니기만 했어요.
English: to do nothing but X / to only do X
Sentence Translation: After getting married Gyeonu and Jiknyeo did nothing but play and hang out every day.

Example Sentence: 견우와 직녀는 까마귀와 까치가 만든 다리 위를 조심스럽게 걸어갔어요.
Sentence Translation: Gyeonu and Jiknyeo carefully walked across the bridge made by the crows and magpies.

Example Sentence: 두 사람은 서로를 안으며 기뻐했어요.
Sentence Translation: The two embraced each other in joy.
